name: Tauri v2 with Vue
description: Tauri configuration, Vue window shell, capability permissions, and Windows runtime verification.

invariants.title: Tauri and Vue implement one titlebar strategy
invariants.statement: Integrated mode disables native decorations and provides one Vue titlebar with a non-interactive drag region and working window controls; native-explicit mode keeps decorations and removes duplicate controls.
preflight: Set the project window shell decision before styling the application.
Keep content-header borders inside the content region.
evidence: The Windows Tauri window has no unintended native white titlebar.
Drag, double-click, minimize, maximize, restore, and close work.
The titlebar and sidebar meet without a protruding content border.

invariants.title: Window method and ACL permission match
invariants.statement: Each invoked Tauri window method has its matching v2 core permission on the target capability; close and destroy remain different contracts.
preflight: Scan actual frontend calls before choosing capability entries.
Use close for normal shutdown unless force-destroy is explicitly required.
evidence: close maps to core:window:allow-close and destroy maps to core:window:allow-destroy.
The real target window runs without a not-allowed error.

invariants.title: All Tauri close requests share one coordinator
invariants.statement: Vue controls, the native close control, keyboard shortcuts, and Rust CloseRequested behavior converge on one idempotent save and exit chain.
preflight: Define how frontend save completion reaches the final close command.
evidence: Both custom and system close preserve dirty state.
Save failure or conflict leaves the window recoverable.

checks.message: A Tauri configuration file is required.

checks.name: vue
checks.message: Vue must be declared in package.json.
This template governs Tauri v2 projects.
Tauri decorations, Vue controls, window methods, and capability permissions must form one complete shell.

manual_verification.title: Windows Tauri shell runtime
steps: Run a real Tauri window on Windows.
Exercise drag, double-click, minimize, maximize, restore, and close.
Inspect light, dark, 100 percent, and 125 percent layouts for border or titlebar drift.

manual_verification.title: Capability and close runtime
steps: Create dirty project state and close from Vue.
Repeat with the native close control.
Confirm persisted state after restart and confirm no permission error in the UI or terminal.
